products.name: Classic Chyawanprash
products.shortDesc: A traditional Ayurvedic rasayana made with amla and 40+ herbs.
products.description: Classic Chyawanprash is a time-honoured Ayurvedic preparation, slow-cooked with fresh amla, ghee, honey and a blend of traditional herbs. It is traditionally taken daily to support natural immunity and everyday vitality for the whole family.

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight

products.ingredients: Amla, Ashwagandha, Guduchi, Pippali, Shatavari, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Ghee, Honey
products.usage: 1 to 2 teaspoons once or twice daily, preferably with warm milk. Children above 5 years: 1 teaspoon daily.

products.name: Giloy Juice
products.shortDesc: Pure Giloy (Guduchi) stem juice, no added sugar.
products.description: Cold-extracted juice of the Giloy (Tinospora cordifolia) stem. Traditionally used in Ayurveda as a rasayana to support the body's natural defence and overall wellness.

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight

products.usage: 20 to 30 ml with an equal quantity of water, once or twice daily on an empty stomach.

products.name: Tulsi Drops (Holy Basil)

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight

products.ingredients: Rama Tulsi, Krishna Tulsi, Vana Tulsi, Amrita Tulsi, Kapoor Tulsi

products.name: Triphala Churna
products.shortDesc: Classic blend of Amalaki, Bibhitaki and Haritaki.

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight

products.name: Hingvashtak Churna

products.name: Aloe Vera Juice

faqs.q: How do I place an order?
faqs.a: Add products to your cart, sign in or create an account, enter your delivery details and place the order. You will receive an invoice by email.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Depending on the store settings you can pay by Cash on Delivery, UPI, QR scan or card. When online payment is switched off, simply send your order by Email or WhatsApp and we will confirm payment details with you.
Orders are usually dispatched within 1 to 2 working days. Delivery takes 3 to 7 working days depending on your location.
Unopened and unused products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Please contact us with your order number.

faqs.q: Are these products a substitute for medical advice?
faqs.a: No. Ayurvedic products support general wellness and are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Please consult a qualified physician, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, on medication or have a medical condition.

faqs.q: I forgot my password. What can I do?
faqs.a: Use "Forgot password" on the login page and confirm your registered email and mobile number to set a new password.
